parties.respondent: High Court Of Madhya Pradesh & Another

summary: Termination of women judicial officers during probation; suo moto cognizance taken; reconsideration by Full Court directed; four reinstated with fresh probation; two excluded—Sarita Choudhary and Aditi Kumar Sharma—based on ACRs, disposal stats, adverse remarks; lack of confirmation not automatically invalid; procedural fairness and judicial review standards examined; proportionality of termination assessed; challenge to grounds of non-confirmation.
legal_provisions_cited: Article 311(2) of the Constitution of India
Madhya Pradesh Judicial Service (Recruitment and Conditions of Service) Rules, 1994
final_judgment: Details of judgment disposition not fully specified in truncated text; pending evaluation of sealed materials and final determination on termination of Sarita Choudhary and Aditi Kumar Sharma.
